Name: lilico's Shie Portrait Edits (Clint)
Author: atelier99
Description:
[b]!!This mod uses Portraiture!![/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Check out Portraiture here![/url]﻿
[center][size=5][u]♡ ﻿lilico's shie hi-res portrait edit (clint ver.) ♡[/u][/size]
[i]initial release: 7/23/2021 version 1.0.0[/i][/center]
[b]CREDIT[/b] goes to Shie for the original portraits! I got express permission from Shie before posting this mod.

Basically, I just edited the Clint portrait to match a Naver portrait I really liked + added new portraits to make him compatible with Looking for Love!

This edit adds onto Clint's 4 original portraits! I figured I'd share it with others who also enjoy Shie's portraits and use LfL (or other romance mods). The expressions are based off the ones in LfL, so they match the dialogue found there! These portraits CAN be used without LfL if you just want a nicer Clint to look at ;-)
[center]﻿[i]ORIGINAL:[/i]
[b]SHIE's PORTRAITS by Shielia[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4264]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4264[/url]﻿[/center]
Installation for [b]Portraiture[/b]
1. Unpack [b]"lilico's Shie Portrait Edit (Clint).zip"[/b]
2. Place [b]"Clint.png"[/b] and [b]"Clint_IslandSouth.png"[/b] in [b]"Portraiture > Portraits > [folder name, ex. Shie]"[/b]

[b]Any other installation questions?[/b]
Reference the ORIGINAL installation instructions if you're lost on how to install it.
